    c = d.get("coconut oil", 0)
    u = d.get("sunflower oil", 0) + d.get("canola oil", 0)
    s = d.get("potato starch", 0)
    X.append([p, c, u, s])
    y.append(e["target_dissimilarity"])

        w = np.exp(params[4:8])
